div.div: 5 تنّدحت الغَنَمُ مِن مَّرَابِضِهَا , (S, K,) or فِى مَرَابِضِهَا, (A, L, &c.,) and ↓ انتدحت , (TA,) The sheep, or goats, became dispersed from, (S, K,) or in, (A, L, &c.,) their nightly restingplaces, and became distended by repletion. (S, A, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
